initial_findings.message: Service account token automounted: set automountServiceAccountToken: false unless the API is needed
May run as root (runAsNonRoot not true or runAsUser 0)
Image uses :latest or has no tag/digest: ghcr.io/example/admin-panel
Service exposed via LoadBalancer: use ClusterIP behind an Ingress/gateway
No NetworkPolicy in this manifest bundle: consider a default-deny NetworkPolicy

validators_initial.name: kube-linter
issues: host-network: Deployment/admin-panel: resource shares host's network namespace (via hostNetwork=true).

latest-tag: Deployment/admin-panel: The container "web" is using an invalid container image, "ghcr.io/example/admin-panel". Please use images that are not blocked by the `BlockList` criteria : [".*:(latest)$" "^[^:]*$" "(.*/[^:]+)$"]
no-read-only-root-fs: Deployment/admin-panel: container "web" does not have a read-only root file system
run-as-non-root: Deployment/admin-panel: container "web" is not set to runAsNonRoot
unset-cpu-requirements: Deployment/admin-panel: container "web" has cpu request 0
unset-memory-requirements: Deployment/admin-panel: container "web" has memory limit 0

attempts.rationale: Fixed hostNetwork, automountServiceAccountToken, added securityContext with runAsNonRoot, non-zero runAsUser, dropped capabilities, set allowPrivilegeEscalation false and readOnlyRootFilesystem true, added resource requests/limits, pinned image tag, changed Service type to ClusterIP.
attempts.proposed_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: admin-panel
  namespace: internal
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: admin-panel
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: admin-panel
    spec:
      hostNetwork: false
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: ghcr.io/example/admin-panel:v1.2.3
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          securityContext:
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1000
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "50m"
              memory: "64Mi"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: admin-panel
  namespace: internal
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: admin-panel
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080

findings.message: No NetworkPolicy in this manifest bundle: consider a default-deny NetworkPolicy

drifts.detail: hostNetwork was turned off: node IP and host ports are no longer used by the workload
service account token is no longer mounted: breaks the app if it calls the Kubernetes API
image tag changed latest -> v1.2.3: behaviour depends on what that tag contains
now runs as non-root (runAsUser 1000): the image must support that user
root filesystem is read-only and no writable volume is mounted: apps that write temp/log/cache files will crash
resource limits added: too-low values cause OOMKills or CPU throttling
Service type LoadBalancer -> ClusterIP: clients outside the cluster can no longer reach it

intent.note: A security-clean patch changed what the workload does. Review before proposing.
